<!-- pr-reviewer: 55fda4df54ceae3a24d1722b6c28a7cf649a7463 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The cone and rounded tip now reach the profile radius at the flute top when the shoulder is at least 0.000001 mm wide. The shoulder adds no cutter atom. I found no production caller of `Tool::meridian()`. No recorded programs or goldens changed.

### Local results

The trial merge used upstream/main at `ea19c3f2167e20f1ea1328563ed29c0e066591da`.

- Quick gate passed. The tools library suite passed all 136 tests.
- Tools Clippy passed with warnings treated as errors.
- The five light suites passed all 11 tests. The release build step failed on the trial merge and on bare upstream/main at `98caf2dfdd4e4ee93f4c29918d2e77e378a7194e`. Both builds reported the same error at lines 49 and 135 of `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs`:

  ```text
  error[E0560]: struct `camcraft_app::operation::WireContourOp` has no field named `start`
  ```

  This failure is already on main. I found no issue that tracks this build failure.

### Extra suites run

- The tools test targets passed all 181 tests, including the 136 library tests.
- The simulation library passed all 252 tests, including `meridian_atoms_match_cutter_atoms_for_each_mill_kind`.

### Mutations

- With the cone shoulder disabled, the regression test failed on the taper. At 5 mm along the axis, the radius was 1.3397459621556136 mm. The expected radius was 5 mm.
- With the rounded shoulder disabled, the same test failed on the ball nose. At 3 mm along the axis, the radius was 4.58257569495584 mm. The expected radius was 5 mm.
- After restoration, the regression test passed.

### Requested before merge

1. `AGENTS.md:319` (PR description, line 54). Move the Claude Code attribution above `Fixes #3938`. The project rule requires the PR description to end with `Fixes #3938`.

I did not run the full heavy lanes. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Moved the Claude Code attribution above `Fixes #3938` in the PR description.

The last-line check failed on the original description and passed on the saved description. The head is `55fda4df54ceae3a24d1722b6c28a7cf649a7463`. The quick gate passed 1 step. Tools Clippy and the example catalog suite passed.

Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 55fda4df54ceae3a24d1722b6c28a7cf649a7463 -->
Re-review of the same head. The review is clean.

### Earlier findings

1. PR description must end with `Fixes #3938`: fixed. The description now ends with `Fixes #3938`. The Claude Code attribution is above it. The author changed only the PR body (comment "Addressed:"). The head did not change.

### Local results

The trial merge used upstream/main at `ddee3aed6064eefe157110ab8923dbb02e1591ca`. The PR diff against that main has 3 files only: `crates/tools/src/meridian.rs`, `crates/tools/src/meridian_tests.rs` and `docs/decisions/3938-cone-shoulder.md`.

- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 1 step, `tools suites: lib`, ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

### Extra suites run

- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib meridian`: 2 passed, 0 failed. This includes `meridian_atoms_match_cutter_atoms_for_each_mill_kind`.
- No file under `testdata/` and no import code changed. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changed.

### Mutations

The earlier review on this same head ran the two mutations (cone shoulder off, rounded shoulder off). The pin test was red for each and green after restore. The code did not change, so I did not run them again.

### Safety tier

`Tool::meridian()` is tool geometry, but no production code calls it today. No posted G-code, gouge check, collision check or stock simulation changes. The full heavy lanes were not run. The author ran `app heavy: tool_body` and `app heavy: verify`: ok.

The release build failure at `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs`, was a failure on main, not in this PR. Newer main changes that file. I did not run the release build again.

Verdict: clean. Label `merge-ready`.
Left for the maintainer: P1 geometry (tool meridian) and a P1 issue (#3938). Only the author review counts (mkinney). No merge by the sweep.
